query: Morning Consult weekly tracker Trump job performance latest

results.content: President Trump's approval rating has slipped to a new second-term low of 41%, with his net approval underwater by 14 points, according to Morning Consult's latest weekly tracking poll. At the same time, Secretary of State Marco Rubio is closing the gap on Vice President JD Vance in early 2028 Republican primary testing, climbing to 22% support after gaining seven points since July. [...] Among Trump's own voters, 55% now disapprove of his job performance, a warning sign inside his coalition as the 2026 midterms approach. Democrats have widened their generic congressional ballot advantage to 5 points, with all of the party's issue leads growing since early August — including an 18-point edge
results.title: Trump Approval Falls, Rubio Gains on Vance for 2028
